# Honora Hollis

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c4 P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020)</sub>
- **Origin:** The Island  <sub>[v3 c4 P31](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0031)</sub>
- **Role:** Teacher and student  <sub>[v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Nonie  <sub>[v3 c9 P6](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Honora is radiant and blonde. During her visits, she wears elegant silk clothing.

_Sources: [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)_

## Personality

Honora possesses a grave and serious outlook on life, contrasting with more flighty peers. She is ambitious, loyal, and friendly, taking a sensible approach to social situations while sharing deep bonds of affection with her friends.

_Sources: [v2 c13 P34](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0034), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003)_

## Traits

- Grave outlook on existence  <sub>[v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003)</sub>
- Desire for fame  <sub>[v2 c13 P34](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0034)</sub>

## Abilities

- Academic study of Greek  <sub>[v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007)</sub>

## Goals

- Achieve fame  <sub>[v2 c13 P34](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0034)</sub>
- Pursue higher education at Wexcombe  <sub>[v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)</sub>

## History

Honora attended Regent's Academy, where she befriended Nell Harcourt and Mabel Colby. Following her studies, she was assigned to teach at the Delford school. During a stroll with Nell, Isolde, and Odette, she participated in naming Crystal Lake and expressed her goal of achieving fame. On one occasion, she brought her aunt, Mrs. Charlotte E. Varley, and Mrs. Pendexter to visit Nell at Grey Shutters. Later, Honora enrolled at Wexcombe alongside Nell. While walking near a graveyard in Wexcombe, she and Nell met Cressida Lindsay, who introduced them into elite social circles. Honora joined Nell and Mabel Colby in planning to rent a house together in Portmaris managed by Mabel's Aunt Euphemia.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c13 P28](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0028), [v2 c13 P34](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0034), [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 c20 P24](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0024), [v3 c4 P19](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0019), [v3 c4 P29](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0029), [v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)_
